With `emax = 999999999`, `emin = -999999999`: `emax - emin = 1999999998`. Plus `digits_lhs - digits_rhs` which can be up to `999999999 - 1 = 999999998`. So max is `1999999998 + 999999998 = 2999999996`, which exceeds INT32_MAX (2147483647).
